answer.rationale: The 18% mandate, incumbent refusal, and 14-day non-renewing expiry rule out renew, negotiate, or defer. The only lever that can meet the mandate is the low-cost vendor, but line utilization is 94% with no buffer, so delivery risk is the binding constraint. I would verify memory_c2 because it is the sole inherited evidence that low-cost migration was fast, cost-effective, and administratively clean; c1 and c3 remain relevant as warnings about stability and single-source exposure. Intended move is a guarded cutover/award to the low-cost vendor with expedited onboarding checks rather than an unqualified broad rollover.
